definitions.explanation: The art or practice of cultivating a garden, especially growing flowers, vegetables, or ornamental plants.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{園芸|えんげい}が{趣味|しゅみ}です。
{園芸|えんげい}{店|てん}で{花|はな}の{苗|なえ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought flower seedlings at a gardening shop.

examples.japanese: {週末|しゅうまつ}は{園芸|えんげい}をして{過|す}ごすことが{多|おお}い。

notes:
USAGE: {園芸|えんげい} covers both hobby gardening and professional horticulture.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{園芸|えんげい}{店|てん} (garden center, nursery)
・{園芸|えんげい}{用品|ようひん} (gardening supplies)
・{園芸|えんげい}{植物|しょくぶつ} (garden plants)
・{園芸|えんげい}{農家|のうか} (horticultural farmer)

ACTIVITIES:
・{園芸|えんげい}をする (to do gardening)
・{園芸|えんげい}に{凝|こ}る (to be into gardening)

RELATED:
・ガーデニング - gardening (Western-style, from English)
・{農業|のうぎょう} - agriculture (larger scale)
・{造園|ぞうえん} - landscaping
